QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Invitation to Ellin Forest
QuestInfo.0: According to Spiegelmann, due to the failure in the Ludibrium Clocktower, people can now travel back in time. He asked you if you're interested in time travel, and you answered that you are curious about Maple World of the past.
QuestInfo.2: Travel to the past through the #bBroken Gate of Time at Helios Tower (101st Floor)#k.
QuestInfo.1: According to Spiegelmann, you can travel back in time through #bHelios Tower (101st Floor), Broken Gate of Time#k in Ludibrium. Try traveling back in time using the Broken Gate of Time.

0.0: Hello there! So, how's life? Anything exciting happening? I've got something exciting for you, if you're interested.
0.1: The Toy Castle of Ludibrium is where time was stopped, as a way to preserve the innocence of childhood. The two towers that hold the place up control the flow of time, but one of the towers is malfunctioning. It's so bad, in fact, that people can slip back through time there, to the past!
0.2: Now, why am I telling you all this? Heh, no reason. I just want everyone to be able to enjoy messing around with the very fabric of time itself. The #e#bBroken Gate of Time on the 101st Floor of Helios Tower#k#n is your ticket to the past. Have fun changing history!
